<video
    src="../_static/videos/ParticleCountingTube.mp4"
    poster="../_static/images/ParticleCountingTube_final.png"
    controls
    loop
    playsinline
    preload="metadata"
    width="100%"
    style="max-width: 900px; display: block;"
    aria-label="Animation showing fluid tracer particles moving through a fixed cross-sectional area A. During time t, the fluid travels distance d, forming a cylindrical volume Ad and illustrating the flow-rate relationship Q equals A times average velocity.">
    Your browser does not support the HTML5 video element.
</video>

<video
    src="../_static/videos/ContinuityFlow.mp4"
    poster="../_static/images/ContinuityFlow_final.png"
    controls
    loop
    playsinline
    preload="metadata"
    width="100%"
    style="max-width: 900px; display: block;"
    aria-label="Animation of incompressible fluid flowing through a pipe that narrows from cross-sectional area A1 to A2. The fluid moves more slowly in the wider section and faster in the narrower section, showing that the same volume flow rate is maintained and illustrating the continuity equation A1 v1 equals A2 v2."
</video>

<video src="../_static/videos/PoiseuilleVesselComparison.mp4"
       poster="../_static/images/PoiseuilleVesselComparison_final.png"
       controls loop playsinline preload="metadata"
       style="width:100%; max-width:900px; height:auto; display:block; margin:auto;"
       aria-label="Animation comparing Poiseuille flow through a normal blood vessel and a plaque-narrowed blood vessel. Both vessels have the same pressure difference, viscosity, and length. Red blood cells move more rapidly through the vessel with the larger radius, while narrowing increases resistance and reduces the volume flow rate.">
    Your browser does not support embedded MP4 video. 
</video>

<video
    src="../_static/videos/diffusion.mp4"
    poster="../_static/images/diffusion_final.png"
    controls
    loop
    playsinline
    preload="metadata"
    style="width: 100%; max-width: 900px; height: auto; display: block; margin: auto;"
    aria-label="Diffusion animation showing random particle motion, a decreasing concentration gradient, and live histograms with dashed equilibrium guides. Blue indicates higher density, red lower density, and white approximately uniform density.">
    Your browser does not support the HTML5 video element.
</video>
